entries.source_evidence: V's exact question to the quiet support worker KN-S1 at first staffed Eastwatch-bound lay-by Day279 about10:15AM, after peaceful Elen/Vos paperwork dispute: "What? Are they prisoners who’ve committed crimes? Or are you trying to tell me something else?" User asks a direct assessment of legal detention vs medical abuse, without agreeing to intervene or committing money/time/combat. KN-S1 is one of four EXISTING support workers attached to Station Kestrel, now at yard collecting two empty military transport cases. They answer from strictly limited firsthand knowledge: they do not know proven criminal charges or convictions; some may have originally been prisoners but KN-S1 cannot truthfully certify none committed offenses. They were officially told the facility is a recovery station for soldiers and other patients; their firsthand exposure now includes 11 living people kept there, six awake and able to speak, three so impaired they cannot walk, and two distressed/restrained. KN-S1 personally witnessed procedures continuing despite subjects' nonconsent and pleas to stop; they believe these are involuntary experiments rather than ordinary lawful treatment, without certifying their full legal status, mechanisms, senior perpetrators or the secret Western Program. Cirren independently asks, "Are you saying they're being used for experiments?" KN-S1 affirms that is what they are trying to convey based on what they actually saw. They offer a copied personal duty sheet and a road itinerary as available evidence if V elects to examine them, but no paper/location has yet been physically handed to the party, documents not yet independently verified or transfer authorized by V. KN-S1 seeks safe care/release for patients, not revenge, and has not promised payment, demanded V assist or joined V's caravan. Their reply is a deliberate private discussion out of immediate sergeant's hearing; Sergeant Adren Vos not magically aware. Sella's separate cargo checks may proceed. No V's additional speech, persuasion/insight checks, magical detection, purchases, acceptance, time loss beyond several minutes, combat or resource spend. Prior Day279 public civilian receipt dispute peacefully resolved, civilian fittings remain civilian's and military can collect own two empty cases. V party stats remain V48/48 HP HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 full, Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 slots all full, Fenar59/59 HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara unharmed, four healthy owned horses/intact coach, purse969gp3sp6cp, rations18 person-days/feed24 animal-days, one unused sealed Pixie Dust, LongRest3/6. Day279 time~10:18, daytime d100FACE90 no random encounter already resolved; no additional roll/night. This is continuing significant dialogue but not a completed new milestone requiring a second sync; former marker quest_milestone has already been recorded at prior commit, so later ordinary append removes any obsolete current top-level sync_trigger without deleting evidence.

entries.source_evidence: Day279 roughly10:20AM at first staffed eastbound Caer Veylan–Eastwatch freight lay-by. V's exact in-character instruction in reply to the independent Station Kestrel supply worker KN-S1's warning of nonconsensual painful treatment of eleven persons: "This is also the Veyren Military… not sure if we want to make an enemy of the whole state. But we will hear you out and see if we can help or not." This explicitly authorizes hearing evidence and possible evaluation, NOT accepting a rescue, traveling to Kestrel, attacking/defying Commonwealth personnel, paying a deposit, abandoning Harrow & Pike escort, or volunteering V's speech beyond player words. The supply worker acknowledges genuine risks of antagonizing Veyran military without pretending an independent Veyran authority can guarantee immunity. To avoid casual official eavesdropping, the worker leads V and independently accompanying Cirren a few steps behind V's own carriage, within sight of Mara/Fenar; no stealth check required merely to speak quietly amid ordinary active freight yard, no direct detection/alert/authority claim. Worker presents but DOES NOT transfer a personal folded copied duty allocation sheet, with heading Station Kestrel — Veteran Recovery Facility, assignment of 11 patients across ordinary/secure wards, ordinary handling supplies for three immobile patients and director's office listed as DIRECTOR CORVEN NASK; this is one already prepared actual witness copy, not a newly discovered signed criminal order, trial instructions or full patient register. The attendant has personally made supply deliveries inside the compound and testifies: six patients awake/mobile, three cannot walk, two separately restrained; observed painful procedures despite spoken nonconsent. They cannot swear patients' prior legal charges or that all military staff knew, and the copy proves facility, staff assignment and ward logistics rather than proving wrongful abuse by itself. Cirren independently notes distinction between real paperwork and independently proving coercion; worker agrees patients/witnesses or site evidence would corroborate. The worker gives actual route description as far as firsthand logistics: from Caer Veylan's northern receiving road 24 road miles north, then8 rough cart-capable service-track miles northwest, total roughly32 road miles from Caer Veylan, 1⅔ typical unloaded road/travel days, slower with transported patients; not a side entrance on this current Eastwatch road and not an instant detour. The facility is an official guarded military administration/recovery compound, but exact defender abilities/secret lab truth/named godslaying cause not revealed or claimed as public. Cirren independently warns V that outright military attack could have consequences and no presumption that every official knows abuses; worker acknowledges prior belief in legitimate recovery. Worker offers actual itinerary and firsthand account for V to decide about, not asking revenge and not falsely promising money, official protection or state-wide enemy status. The duty sheet remains KN-S1's possession at end; no actual handoff/photocopy or record export, no caravan contract revised, no new consent from Sella for diversion. Elen Turr civil fittings already released, Sergeant Vos processing his two genuinely military empty cases elsewhere. Day279 approx10:20; no dice, attack, spells, abilities, time-consuming investigative ritual, inventory/coin/supply transfer. V48/48 HP HD7/7 full Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 and Fighter resources, Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 full L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3, Fenar59/59 HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy, four owned healthy horses and intact coach, purse969gp3sp6cp, provisions18 ration-person-days/24 horse-feed animal-days, sole sealed unused Pixie Dust, LongRest3/6. No Day279 new random occurrence (prior actual daytime d10090), future overnight or ongoing civilian arrest. Next V decision whether seek independent corroboration, ask worker specific questions, seek third-party help, stay with Sella's Eastwatch caravan or accept different risk; no new mission already accepted.
